subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A cold fish
solution:
The correct answer is **"An unemotional person"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given Idiom **"A cold fish" **is** "An unemotional person"**.
 
• A cold fish means an **unsympathetic and unfriendly person **with a harsh personality.
 
 
• **Example: **Misty acted like a cold fish towards her mother.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
 

 **Idioms**
 **Meanings**
 **Example**
 
 

 **A nervous person: **
 
 
Fear of the result in real life as well as in their imaginary world. 

 
 A nervous person does not have patience. 
 
 

 **A boring person: **
 Monotonous/ lifeless. 
 The life of a boring person is interesting among his close ones. 
 
 

 **A sensitive person: **
 
 
Who is very emotional and can feel the pain of others. 

 
 
 
A five-year girl is a more sensitive person than a twenty-one.
